conclusions.actual_lineup_check_note: Official confirmed lineup (tottenhamhotspur.com, corroborated by spurs-web.com and lastwordonsports.com) checked ~1hr pre-kickoff. Material change from the pre-match assumption: Solanke starts for Tottenham (was assumed absent), with Kudus and Maddison fit enough for the bench; Gomes and Manzambi start for Villa (also assumed absent), with Abraham on the bench. Both sides recovered much more of their assumed-missing personnel than either analyst modelled. Claude treated this as material and revised its own probability estimate downward for Villa (0.31->0.29 -- see collaboration/claude-input.json for full reasoning), which nearly halves Claude's edge on this selection to +4.0pp -- thin, and flagged as a borderline call for the owner. Codex's probability was not independently re-run (no live Codex process available this session); its edge shown here is the original, unrevised probability recomputed only against today's confirmed price. Both books' numbers still clear the 3pp threshold as of this check, so the conclusion selection continues to hold, but on a materially thinner and partly unverified basis than when it was first agreed -- not a clean holdover.
